info.title: actualBudget API
info.description: Trusted-network application with no app login, cookies or bearer tokens. Native requests without Origin are supported. Browser API requests must match the configured public origin (or HTTP Host origin); cross-site fetches are rejected. All identifiers are canonical lowercase UUIDs; account/transaction identities are budget-scoped. Unknown JSON fields are rejected.

parameters.description: Include retained deleted-budget identities for recovery; never includes their removed active data.

Same normalized payload replays original 201 result after restart; different payload returns 409 idempotency_conflict. Successful writes and replay outcome commit atomically. Retained indefinitely until a safe acknowledgement protocol exists.

get.description: Ordinary ledger entries ordered by date descending, creation order descending, then ID. With account_id, running_balance includes all preceding entries and does not reset per page; all-account rows return null. Default totals include future dates. Explicit as_of limits balances and entries inclusively to that calendar date. Newest account page uses cached totals and an indexed bounded row read. Tombstoned entries are excluded. Every response includes an opaque snapshot token. Send it unchanged on subsequent pages with the same filters. Any committed server mutation may conservatively invalidate it (including writes in another budget); a 409 register_changed requires discarding accumulated pages and reloading from offset zero. Unchanged reads and idempotent mutation replays preserve the token. Rows, totals and token share one read-only database snapshot. Raw offset without snapshot remains supported but does not guarantee consistency across requests.

parameters.name: snapshot
parameters.description: Opaque token from the first page; preserve unchanged for consistent continuation.

200.description: Register page and exact all-date or explicit as-of balances

409.description: register_changed: discard accumulated pages and reload from offset zero

parameters.name: X-Actual-Edit-Clock
parameters.description: Persist with Idempotency-Key before sending; same key/body with changed clock conflicts. Absent header supports historical callers/receipts. New clients must supply stable original intent ordering.

parameters.name: X-Actual-Cancel-If-Uncommitted
parameters.description: Atomically return the original receipt or record terminal operation_canceled409 before any edit. Keep original method/path/body/idempotency key/edit clock unchanged. The cancellation header is excluded from the operation fingerprint; delayed original attempts replay the cancellation. Lost acknowledgement requires unchanged retry. Supported only on transaction mutation routes.

post.description: New payee/category objects are created in the same transaction as the financial write and durable replay outcome; select an ID or create a reference, never both. Off-budget entries cannot have a category. Financial values and every account running/cleared/uncleared balance must remain safe integers. Per-field newest HLC wins; independent fields merge and superseded fields are reported. Accepted/rejected-delete outcomes replay durably. Unpublished deletions older than any known field are rejected; published tombstones stay hidden while newer ordinary fields may still merge. No operation, clock, or tombstone retention expiry is applied.

post.description: Pure calculator input conversion, no idempotency key required. Canonical decimal dot input, whitespace ignored, + - * / ^ and parentheses. Baseline binary64 expression evaluation and Math.round-compatible ties toward positive infinity; negative primaries precede exponentiation, exponentiation is right-associative, valid expression prefixes ignore trailing characters. Nonfinite/out-of-range results rejected. Ledger storage and calculations remain exact integers.

get.description: Read latest affected entities and retained tombstones after an atomic initial register checkpoint. Coalesced state is ordered by server sequence, not edit time; concurrent changes move later and remain retrievable. Advance only to returned next_cursor; repeat while has_more. Empty refresh writes nothing. Wrong epoch/budget or future cursor gives cursor_invalid; explicitly reload initial views. Retention is indefinite; no silent cursor expiry. Backup restore must rotate budget epochs before serving clients.

post.description: Maximum16MiB compressed,64MiB expanded,128entries,100000rows per inspected table. Malformed/encrypted inputs cannot create budgets. Valid unsupported features remain retained in blocked stages. Archive/audit/receipt commit atomically. Identical SHA deduplicates across keys. ZIP64/multi-disk archives unsupported.

post.description: Ready stages only. Insert source IDs, relationships, preferences, original field order and tombstones; verify target totals before commit.
